text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions at gains, but a realized profit alone does not show that selling was the best choice; I should use a portfolio plan rather than my average cost as the trigger.","The account moved up and down during the months I made no trades, reminding me that short-term changes are not a reason by themselves to act.","I should keep reviewing the whole portfolio and make trades only when they fit my goals, rather than treating each stock as a separate account."]}
